null_policy: Unknown is null; forbid zero/default substitution and automatic pass

wood-elastic.locator: Wood Handbook2021 ch5 printed p5-2, Table5-1 at approx12% moisture; E axial approximation=1.1*E bending; ER/EL and ET/EL ratios

wood-teak.locator: Table5-5a continuation PDFp21, teak Tectona grandis,12% MC: MOR100700kPa,E10700MPa; compilation of world literature, not a graded stock certificate

ahec-oak.locator: Mechanical Properties, 12% moisture; Quercus species mainly Q. alba

ahec-ash.locator: Mechanical Properties, 12% moisture; Fraxinus species incl. F. americana; live page E=11977 (not 11997 in one comparative table)

ahec-beech.locator: Mechanical Properties, 12% moisture; Fagus grandifolia, NOT European beech/hornbeam

ahec-walnut.locator: Mechanical Properties, 12% moisture; Juglans nigra, NOT generic European walnut

ahec-cherry.locator: Mechanical Properties, 12% moisture; Prunus serotina, NOT all cherries

wood-handbook.locator: 2021 edition ch.5 orthotropic clear wood; ch.7 graded design; ch.8 fastenings; ch.12 composites

mdf-egger.locator: 2025-07-24, MDF Light E1 ELS recipe 522; thickness >12–19 mm; density specific to plant; EN310

p2-egger.locator: 2025-07-14, P2 EN312 recipe001; thickness >13–20 mm; EN310; density plant-specific

plywood-metsa.locator: Birch plywood; exact thickness/layup/direction-specific technical declaration required

al-hydro.locator: 6082 extruded products Rev2 01/2019; density 2.71 g/cm3, E70GPa

brass-cda.locator: C26000: specific gravity8.53, tensile E16000ksi; unit conversion 1ksi=6.894757293MPa

stone-nsi.locator: ASTM C97 density; C880 flexural strength; C99 MOR; C1352 flexural E; C1354 anchorage. Values require quarry/batch/test direction, not a generic stone constant

notes: physics.js imports WOODS but uses class-level DENSITY/E_MOD in mass/deflection
No species transverse modulus, connector pull-out or general frame connection stiffness model
These baseline values are source observations, not sourced material certificates
